body: A coding agent for open models like Kimi K3.1 and GLM 5.3
plain_description: **Give your team a coding agent that works with low-cost models.** Switch between model providers and agent harnesses from the terminal. Use it with compatible editors and clients through ACP.
technical_description: A Rust-based coding agent forked from OpenAI Codex, designed to emulate agent harnesses for low-cost models. It runs in a terminal, supports multiple model providers and harnesses, native sandboxing on macOS, Linux, and Windows, and integrations including ACP, MCP, and the Codex exec protocol.
title: Open Interpreter
